ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgEapStatus
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Register to indicate if an EAP was activated. There is one status bit per EAP in bits [15:0] (Node0Eap0..Node3Eap3, 4 EAPs per Node across 4 Nodes) and one write-to-clear bit per EAP in bits [47:32] (Node0Eap0W2C..Node3Eap3W2C); write the matching w2c bit to reset a status bit. The register is used by SW to know if an action was taken (ex: NMI ISR needs to know which of the EAP triggered the NMI)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EnableEap

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EnableCla
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set this bit to 1 to enable the CLA functional clock; clear it to 0 to gate that clock (save pwr). The CLA register block runs on a clock whose functional enable is tied high, so this bit can still be written while the functional clock is gated

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ClaChainLoopDelay
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Creates a window in which we don’t forward the incoming Xtrigger and Clock_Halt signal

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableGlobalClockHalt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If this bit is set, clock halt action is not applied to global clocks

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableLocalClockHalt

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the field is set tp 2'b10, sent timestamp. All other vlaues not NA.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstsyncmax
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When trDstSyncMode is set to 2'b10, timestamp will be sent for every 2^(trDstSyncMax + 4) Cluster clocks.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstformat
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: bit[0]: XOR Enable, bit[1]: VLT Enable. Supported values : 2'b3 (XOR+VLT Compression), 2'b1 (XOR Compresion), 2'b0 (No Compression)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorframelength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify frame length. Frame Length = trDstVendorFrameLength* 64 ; Frame Length should be a multiple of Bank Data Width.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorstreamlength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify Stream length. A stream starts with "no compressed packet". Stream length specifies number of frames before a non-compressed packet is sent.Stream Length = 32* 2^(trDstVendorStreamLength + 1)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdsttimestampconfig
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: DST timestamp configuration. 0: timestamp input form external source (CoreTime). 1: timestamp from CLA timesync.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceSourceId
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Trace Source ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceFrameFillByte
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use "Filler Packet" to align a stream of trace packets within a frame boundary.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameLenghtInBytes
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use trDstImpl[trDstVendorFrameLength] for Frame Length programming. Register field ZBB-ed.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameModeEnable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Frame Mode (Frame Mode: Always pack "frame length" number of bytes for trace transmission). If flush to memory is stalled (due to silicon bug), we can have incomplete packets in memory. Frame Mode will help SW decoder to avoid reading incomplete trasnmitted packets. In Frame Mode, SW will get a memory pointer that is aligned to Frame Length. HW will ensure there are no incomplete packets incluced in the region pointed by memory pointer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameClosureMode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Closure Mode: 1: Close frame with a packet no larger than max packet size before any overflow (due to packets crossing frame boundary). 0: Close frame when packets cross boundary. Push back packet crossing frame boundary to packet generator.
